title: Test :4 DSSSB TGT Computer Science - Arithmetical and Numerical Ability (24 June 2023, Shift 2)

questions.q: Let x be the least number which when divided by 11, 21, 24 and 28, leaves a remainder of 10 in each case. If x is divisible by 37, what will be the sum of the digits of x?

A man travels the first 2 hours at a speed of 45 km/h, the next 3 1/2 hours at a speed of 60 km/h and the next 4 1/2 hours at a speed of 70 km/h. What is his average speed (in km/h) for the entire journey?

The ratio of spirit and water in solution A is 6 : 7 and the ratio of water and spirit in solution B is 9 : 4. 3 L of A is mixed with 5 L of B. In 780 mL of the resulting solution, what is the quantity (in mL) of spirit?
The price of tea increased by 40% and then decreased by 20%. If a person now reduces his consumption of tea by 6 1/4%, then what is the percentage change in his expenditure?
By selling an article at 23/40 of its selling price, a shopkeeper loses 8%. If it is sold at 90% of its original selling price, then the profit percentage is:

An article is sold for ₹351.90 after giving two successive discounts of x% and 15% on its marked price of ₹450. If a single discount of 2x% is given on its marked price, then its selling price will be:

Two numbers, A and B, are in the ratio of 10 : 13. If 90 is subtracted from each of them, the resulting numbers are in the ratio of 7 : 10. If 57 is added to A and 16 is subtracted from B, then the ratio of the resulting numbers will be:

P and Q started a business by investing their capitals in the ratio of 1 : 2 and the period of P's investment is three times that of Q. If P received a profit of ₹22,800, then what is the total profit?
x varies directly as y and inversely as z. When y = 1.5 and z = 2, then x = 5. If z = 2.5 and y = 9, then what is the value of x?
The simple interest on a certain sum for 10 years at 9.5% p.a. is ₹2,832 less than the amount of the same sum for 3 1/2 years at 7% p.a., simple interest. The sum (in ₹) is:
A loan of ₹10,200 is to be paid back in two equal half-yearly instalments. If the rate of interest is 8% p.a., compounded half-yearly, then what is the total interest charged in this scheme?
A 240-m-long train passes a pole in 18 seconds and completely passes another train running in the opposite direction at a speed of 42 km/h in 17 seconds. What is the length of the other train?

The time taken by a boat to go 21 km downstream is equal to the time taken by it to go 9 km upstream. To go 12 km downstream and the same distance upstream, it takes a total of 5 5/7 hours. How much time (in hours) will the boat take to go 28 km downstream?

Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 hours and 30 hours, respectively. Pipe C is an emptying pipe. When all the three pipes are opened together, 2/9th part of the tank is filled in 8 hours. Pipe C alone can empty 1/3rd part of the tank in:
The volume of a right circular cylinder is 554.4 cm³ and its height is 10 cm. What is the perimeter of the base of the cylinder? (Use π = 22/7)
The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 444π cm³ and the diameter of its base is 24 cm. What is the volume of the cone (in cm³)?
The area of a rectangular field is 1008 m². Its shorter side is 1/8 of the sum of its longer side and one of its diagonals. What is the cost of fencing the field at ₹24 per m?

Study the given pie chart and answer the following question.

Breakup (percentage-wise) of amount spent on different sports in 2021 in a school: Cricket 22.50%, Golf 12%, Others 12.50%, Basketball 15%, Football 18%, Hockey 20%.

Amount spent on cricket = ₹18,000

If the total amount spent on Basketball and Hockey is ₹x more than the total amount spent on Football and Golf, then the value of x lies between:

Study the given graph and answer the following question.

Production of rice by states A, B and C during 2018 to 2020 (in lakh tonnes): A - 450, 500, 600; B - 550, 470, 650; C - 620, 600, 720 (for years 2018, 2019, 2020 respectively).

The average production of rice (per year) by states A, B and C in 2018 is what percentage less than the production of rice by state C in 2020?
